meta.source: UN Comtrade (partner-reported and Kiribati-reported HS6 monthly data)
notes: Values in USD millions. null = not available (the dataset is not published or was not pulled); it is never 0.

Partner-reported exports = what Kiribati's partners record as imports from Kiribati (partner flow M); partner-reported imports = what partners record as exports to Kiribati (partner flow X). Kiribati-reported = Kiribati's own customs returns on Comtrade (flows X and M).

All-goods partner series exist only for the months Kiribati itself reported (the pipeline pulled the mirror side for those 70 months). For the other months only the fish series (tuna, all fish, other fish) are available, from a separate fish-only pull that covers every month 2017-01 onward.

Tuna = HS6 ['030341', '030342', '030343', '030344', '030345', '030346', '030349', '030487', '160414'] (frozen albacore, yellowfin, skipjack, bigeye, bluefin and other tunas, frozen tuna fillets, prepared or preserved tuna), as in comtrade_mirror/fish.py. Fish = HS chapter 03 + heading 1604. Copra oil = HS 151311 + 151319. Ships and aircraft = HS chapters 88-89. Fuel = HS 27. Food = HS 01-24 excluding chapter 03.

Quarterly and annual rows are sums of the available months; months_with_partner_data, months_with_fish_data and kiribati_months_reported say how many months are in each sum. Quarters and years with fewer months are not comparable with complete ones.

In quarterly and annual rows the fish series (exports_partner_tuna, _fish, _other_fish) can cover more months than the all-goods series, so exports_partner_tuna may exceed exports_partner (e.g. 2024: tuna over 12 months, all goods over the 10 months Kiribati reported). Use exports_partner_fish_same_months / exports_partner_tuna_same_months when comparing with exports_partner.

Annual rows also carry exports_partner_*_annual_dataset from Comtrade's annual returns (2010-2025), which cover years before 2017 and partners that report annually only; they are kept separate from the monthly sums.

rolling_12m: 12-month totals of partner-reported fish and tuna for every end month; the all-goods total is given only when all 12 months have the all-goods pull. growth_pct compares the fish total with the 12 months a year earlier. Read growth only off this window; single months are noise.
Partner-reported imports are a lower bound (about a third to a half of what Kiribati records). No trade balance is computed from these data.
Partner-reported exports are valued CIF (including freight and insurance) by most reporters; Kiribati-reported exports are FOB.

2024-01: Kiribati-reported import line HS 940690 (Buildings; prefabricated, not of wood) from Viet Nam is published at USD 3,135 million; shown as published in imports_kiribati and set aside in imports_kiribati_ex_flagged.
flagged_lines: 2024-01: Kiribati-reported import line HS 940690 (Buildings; prefabricated, not of wood) from Viet Nam is published at USD 3,135 million; shown as published in imports_kiribati and set aside in imports_kiribati_ex_flagged.

keys.exports_partner: Partner-reported exports from Kiribati, all goods (what partners say they bought from Kiribati)
keys.exports_partner_tuna: Partner-reported exports: tuna (frozen skipjack, yellowfin, bigeye, albacore and other tunas, frozen tuna fillets, canned tuna)
keys.exports_partner_fish: Partner-reported exports: all fish and seafood (HS chapter 03 and heading 1604)
keys.exports_partner_other_fish: Partner-reported exports: fish and seafood other than tuna
keys.exports_partner_ex_fish: Partner-reported exports excluding fish and seafood
keys.exports_partner_ex_fish_ships: Partner-reported exports excluding fish, seafood, ships and aircraft
keys.imports_partner: Partner-reported imports into Kiribati, all goods (what partners say they sold to Kiribati; a lower bound)
keys.imports_partner_ex_ships_aircraft: Partner-reported imports excluding ships and aircraft
keys.imports_partner_food: Partner-reported imports: food, drink and tobacco (HS 01-24 excluding fish)
keys.exports_kiribati: Kiribati-reported exports, all goods (Kiribati's own customs returns)
keys.exports_kiribati_fish: Kiribati-reported exports: all fish and seafood
keys.exports_kiribati_ex_fish: Kiribati-reported exports excluding fish and seafood
keys.imports_kiribati: Kiribati-reported imports, all goods, as published
keys.imports_kiribati_ex_flagged: Kiribati-reported imports with one flagged line set aside (January 2024, HS 940690, USD 3,135 million)
keys.imports_kiribati_ex_ships_aircraft: Kiribati-reported imports excluding ships and aircraft (flagged line also set aside)
keys.imports_kiribati_food: Kiribati-reported imports: food, drink and tobacco (HS 01-24 excluding fish)
keys.n_reporters_exports: Number of partners with at least one export line from Kiribati in the period (all goods pull)
keys.n_reporters_imports: Number of partners with at least one import line into Kiribati in the period (all goods pull)
keys.n_reporters_fish: Number of partners with at least one fish line from Kiribati in the period (fish pull)
keys.pct_complete: Percent complete, count-based (share of the panel published)
keys.pct_complete_w_exports: Percent complete, weighted by export shares
keys.pct_complete_w_imports: Percent complete, weighted by import shares
keys.kiribati_reported: Whether Kiribati's own monthly return for the period is published
keys.partner_all_goods_available: Whether the all-goods partner pull exists for the period (it exists only for months Kiribati reported)
keys.exports_partner_tuna_annual_dataset: Partner-reported tuna from Comtrade's ANNUAL returns (available 2010 onwards; differs slightly from the sum of monthly returns)
keys.exports_partner_fish_annual_dataset: Partner-reported fish and seafood from Comtrade's ANNUAL returns
keys.n_reporters_fish_annual_dataset: Number of partners in the annual fish returns
keys.exports_partner_fish_same_months: Partner-reported fish summed over only the months that have the all-goods pull (so it is comparable with exports_partner)
keys.exports_partner_tuna_same_months: Partner-reported tuna summed over only the months that have the all-goods pull
keys.months_with_partner_data: Months in the period with the all-goods partner pull
keys.months_with_fish_data: Months in the period with partner fish data
keys.kiribati_months_reported: Months in the period with Kiribati's own return published
keys.rolling_12m.growth_pct: Change of the 12-month fish total against the 12 months a year earlier, percent
